[[Named item sets#Curse Necromancer|Curse Necromancer]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Named item sets#Curse Necromancer|Curse Necromancer]]:''' 2 Pieces Equipped:
+5 Artifact bonus to Negative Amplification.
Whenever you cast a Negative or Poison spell, you have a chance to apply a stack of Dreadful Curse, reducing the enemy's fortitude by 1. This can stack up to 3 times, and each stack lasts 30 seconds.
